mapper.select: SELECT current_run_id FROM study_rooms WHERE id=#{roomId} AND user_id=#{userId}
SELECT r.* FROM studyroom_runs r JOIN study_rooms s ON s.id=r.room_id WHERE r.id=#{runId} AND r.user_id=#{userId} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT * FROM studyroom_units WHERE run_id=#{runId} ORDER BY unit_order
SELECT * FROM studyroom_fragments WHERE unit_id=#{unitId} ORDER BY fragment_order
SELECT unit_id FROM studyroom_completed_knowledge WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND run_id=#{runId} AND unit_id=#{unitId}
SELECT * FROM studyroom_learning_progress WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND run_id=#{runId}
